findings.entity: coffee mugs on counter (man's mug and a second mug)
findings.description: At 01:09 only the man's mug is on the counter; the waitress's hands are on the plate and carry no mug. By 01:10 a second white mug is standing behind the plate with no visible placement. The waitress then slides it toward the man (01:12), where it sits beside his own mug, and by 01:13 only one mug remains in his hand. Two mugs have merged into one. Dense frames at 2.5 fps from 69.2 to 73.6s show the extra mug appear and then collapse into the man's mug.

At 01:38 the hand slides a single flat bill (one visible layer) across the counter under its fingers. By 01:39, with no added bills shown, it has become a curled stack of at least three $100 bills in a different spot and a raised, bent orientation. The money count and form change during the hand-off with no visible action that adds bills.

The only vehicle parked at the diner in the opening exterior (00:00-00:10) is a white semi tractor. When the man leaves at 01:41-01:49, he walks to a dark green box truck with a long-nose cab and chrome stacks. The white tractor is never seen leaving and the green truck is never seen arriving, so the parked vehicle has changed identity.
